text.en: Clients frequently praise Dr Thompson, Dr Frost, and the therapy assistants for their thorough explanations and dedicated attention during consultations. Pet parents appreciate that staff members take time to describe rehabilitation plans clearly. Two reviewers had negative experiences regarding scheduling and medication counsel, yet the vast majority commend the clinic for compassionate patient care.

Reviewers emphasize how kindly veterinary nurses and therapists handle dogs and cats during therapy and routine exams. Owners of pets with chronic mobility challenges or post-surgical stiffness note that staff remain patient and encouraging during every session. Clients report that their animals feel comfortable entering the rehabilitation rooms and build strong bonds with the team.

Pet owners report positive medical progress from specialised physical rehabilitation, acupuncture, canine hydrotherapy, and laser therapy. Multiple clients note noticeable improvements in their pets' mobility after orthopaedic surgery or spinal injuries. While one reviewer experienced a tragic medical decline, most owners credit the clinic's therapeutic regimens with restoring their pets' comfort.

q.en: What specialised therapies are offered at Healing Hands?

a.en: The hospital provides canine physical rehabilitation, underwater treadmill hydrotherapy, veterinary acupuncture, and therapeutic laser treatments.

q.en: Are appointments necessary for rehabilitation consultations?

a.en: Yes, therapy and consultation appointments must be scheduled in advance, and clients are advised to arrive promptly for scheduled sessions.

q.en: Can the clinic assist dogs recovering from orthopaedic surgery?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently report successful rehabilitation outcomes for dogs recovering from orthopaedic and spinal surgeries.

q.en: Does Healing Hands have an on-site veterinary pharmacy?

a.en: Yes, the facility maintains an on-site pharmacy stocking prescribed veterinary pharmaceuticals and therapeutic supplements.
